_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Delayed blank-recording draft creation does not hijack a later selection. The test seeded a conversation {{VIEWED}} at /c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). The server's answer to the browser's draft creation (POST /api/conversations/draft) is held back until call "releaseDraft"; call "draftCreated" says ("true" or "false") whether the server has created the draft and, once it has, sets {{DRAFT}} to its conversation ID; call "draftAnswered" says whether the browser has received the answer. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and click the voice button.
2. Call "draftCreated" until it returns "true".
3. Exactly one [data-testid="recording-inline"] should exist, and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts should become 1.
4. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text"), and the voice button should be disabled.
5. Call "releaseDraft", then call "draftAnswered" until it returns "true".
6. The recording panel should be visible, the recorder should float, and the URL should still have exactly the path "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text"). window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts should be 1.
7. Click [data-testid="recording-return-button"]. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{DRAFT}}" (an exact "value", not "text"), and the recorder should not float.
8. Click the cancel button.
